title: Compose capability, impact, trust, and approval into one authority gate
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `authority_gate` over a matrix of evaluate scenarios so untrusted forwarded content cannot authorize an external send and high-impact actions still require configured authority. Related: `fangore_compound_grants`. Tracks MH-PA-02[^insp-pa-02].
implementation: `AuthorityGate.evaluate` composes AccessControl, CapabilityEnvelope, ConsequencePolicy, trust, verdict, and approval. Product verb `authority_gate`. Hosts inject the gate via Config when wiring it onto graph soft-points later.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `authority_gate_evaluate.yaml` drives `authority_gate`; expects the decisions matrix.
